Subject: Zephyr Components — vendor master onboarding: legal entity & PO routing

Hi Emma / AP team,

Thanks for the intro call yesterday — welcome! To get Zephyr set up in our vendor master and route POs correctly, we need a small packet of information and a couple of documents. Can you please provide the items below? If anything requires a secure upload, send the DocuSign/portal link and we'll use that.

Required (high priority):
- Legal company name exactly as registered
- Tax ID / EIN (or local equivalent) and entity type (LLC, C-Corp, etc.)
- Registered/legal address and separate remittance (billing) address if different
- Primary AP contact (name, email, phone) and secondary contact
- Preferred PO routing / invoicing email and EDI/portal details (if any)
- W-9 (or completed tax form for your jurisdiction) attached

Optional but helpful:
- ACH/Bank details (we prefer a secure DocuSign or portal; please do not paste full bank credentials in-line)
- Copy of a bank letter for account name verification (stub acceptable)
- Any vendor codes (DUNS, vendor ID at your side)

I've attached our vendor_onboarding_form.pdf — fill the form and return alongside Zephyr_W9.pdf and the bank-letter.pdf if possible. Once we have this, finance will create the vendor record and confirm the PO routing path.

Target timeline: set up within 3 business days of receiving docs.

Cheers,

Marissa Cole
Procurement Operations
Redwood Inference

On our side: Marissa will create the vendor master record and assign a pending vendor ID; Marcus will block for finance verification and confirm once ACH is validated.

Thanks — copying Marcus so finance can weigh in.
